message.fabrimechanus.no_tree_punching: Are you crazy? Why punch a tree?
jei.fabrimechanus.small_pebble: Right-click to pick up. Sneak-right-click on stone to knap a stone shard.
jei.fabrimechanus.small_flint: Right-click to pick up. Sneak-right-click on stone to knap a flint shard.
jei.fabrimechanus.stone_shard: Hold right-click on grass to cut 1-2 plant fiber.
jei.fabrimechanus.flint_shard: Hold right-click on grass to cut 1-2 plant fiber.
jei.fabrimechanus.plant_fiber: Three plant fiber craft one plant cord.
jei.fabrimechanus.plant_cord: Used to craft the crude stone and flint axes.
jei.fabrimechanus.stone_axe: Durability 10. Charged right-click on stripped wood saws 2 planks.
jei.fabrimechanus.flint_axe: Durability 10. Charged right-click on stripped wood saws 2 planks.
